inline_comments.comment:
The changeset message is vague and omits the CVE identifier. Per project conventions, changeset entries should 'precisely identify the condition under which a bug manifests and describe what the fix actually resolves.' A downstream consumer reading the generated changelog will have no way to associate this entry with CVE-2025-57347. Prefer something like:

`fix: update dagre-d3-es to 7.0.13 to address CVE-2025-57347 (improper sanitization in addConflict)`

Also note the capital 'U' in 'Updated' — by convention every message in this repo's existing changesets uses lowercase after the `fix:` / `feat:` prefix.

general_comments.comment: The target version 7.0.13 appears to already be superseded. Inspecting the repository's `develop` branch shows `packages/mermaid/package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` are currently pinned to `dagre-d3-es@7.0.14`, which was released after 7.0.13. If this PR is targeting `develop`, the base branch has moved ahead and merging as-is would effectively be a no-op (or in the worst case a downgrade if the branch is rebased incorrectly). The author should verify the base branch version and, if 7.0.14 is available and also contains the CVE fix, update the bump target to 7.0.14 to avoid introducing a version older than what `develop` already uses.
